identityConsolidations.reason: Factory literature does not identify a separate 28 Pilothouse; existing image and configuration correspond to the no-flybridge Cruiser.

namingDecision.note: Factory 1986 literature lists Fly Bridge Cruiser, Cruiser, Open Fisherman and 280 Sport; Pilothouse is not a separate model. “Power Cruiser” disambiguates the powerboat from the Cape Dory 28 sailboat.
